## Description
&#10;&#9;&#9;Photoautotrophic Cyanobacteria are useful for an industrial scale, bio-based process. Strains are genetically modified to express &#10;&#9;&#9;the ethylene-forming enzyme (EFE) from Pseudomonas syringae.  This process enables the direct solar-driven conversion of CO2 &#10;&#9;&#9;into ethylene, a volatile hydrocarbon used in the plastic industry, by directing cellular carbon flux toward the primary &#10;&#9;&#9;metabolite 2-oxoglutarate.
